content:
**Old Possum** is a consumable in *Fallout 76*.

A strong malt liquor brewed using aster and Razorgrain. It increases Strength and Charisma by one while also lowering Intelligence by one.

Similar to other fermentable pre-War beverages, Old Possum is initially crafted as fermentable Old Possum, offering no benefits, inflicting 30 rads, and having a significantly high disease chance of 9% until fully fermented. It has a unique orange-colored bottle and an Old Possum label featuring a possum holding a bottle of the liquid.

Old Possum can be crafted using the brewing and distilling functionality of *Wild Appalachia*.
